api:
<Ishikawa data={causes} effect="Oversized bores" category={|c: &Cause| c.group} cause={|c: &Cause| c.reason} />
PropTypeDefault
dataone row per causerequired
effecttext in the headrequired
categoryFn(&T) -> &str: the bonerequired
causeFn(&T) -> &strrequired

Bones alternate above and below the spine in the order categories first appear. Long causes are shortened with "…"; hover a bone to list all its causes.

examples.title: Six Ms
examples.description: Categories alternate above and below the spine; hover a bone to list its causes.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn six_m() {
    let data = use_signal(factory());
    rsx! { <Ishikawa data={data} effect="Oversized bores" category={|c: &Cause| c.group} cause={|c: &Cause| c.reason} class="h-96" /> }
}
